sentences.text: No: for this UCB, penal capitalisation is not permitted, so there is no further interest computed on penal charges.
No: penal interest is not permitted, and the directions say any penalty for non-repayment shall be levied only in the form of penal charges and not penal interest.
The directions also say additional or fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
The older fair-lending circulars are no longer in force or are superseded, so the current UCB directions control this issue.
